title: Dholavira: A Harappan City (India), No 1645 — Advisory Body Evaluation
version: Report approved 18 March 2021; standalone 13-page PDF, printed pp. 13–25.
lineage: ICOMOS synthesis of Indian nomination and excavation documentation plus a 2020 site evaluation. Printed pp. 13–15 inspected via full web PDF extraction. Direct PDF download returned 403; no local original or independent stratigraphic reanalysis claimed. Reservoir construction interval is retrospective Stage III dating.

passages.locator: Printed pp. 14–15, Description and history, Stage III paragraph
passages.quote: Large scale reservoirs were created on the east, south and west of the Castle.
passages.note: The paragraph places this construction in Stage III, c. 2800–2500 BCE.

passages.locator: Printed p. 14, Castle and Bailey description
passages.note: Drainage-to-reservoir relation is described, but its specific construction phase is not established here and is withheld as an edge.
